scientific_role: new independently selected real-system validation of the EOG-WF v2 response-independent eligibility boundary

source_identity.title: Endure – standardised invertebrate sampling in coastal blond dunes from the 2-seas region

response_independent_design_basis.geography: North-France, South-UK, Belgium and the Netherlands along the North Sea-Channel coast
protocol: 15 seconds sweep-netting in and above the tussock
5 minutes manual collection at the base of the tussock

biological_rationale_source.title: Aphids on Ammophila arenaria in Belgium: first reports, phenology and host range expansion

focal_endpoint_selection.rationale: pre-existing literature independently documents this aphid on marram grass; selection is based on host association rather than the Endure occurrence table
focal_endpoint_selection.future_name_matching_rule: after response authorization, normalize scientificName to leading genus plus specific epithet and require exact binomial Metopolophium sabihae; no post-open species switch

prospective_endpoint.candidate_unit: eligible leaf sampling event from the frozen Event core
prospective_endpoint.positive_rule: after full occurrence-extension authorization, at least one present occurrence assigned to normalized binomial Metopolophium sabihae links to the event
prospective_endpoint.negative_rule: after complete occurrence-extension parsing, an otherwise eligible event with no present focal occurrence is a recorded non-detection only
prospective_endpoint.zero_interpretation: sampled-event non-detection, never biological absence outside the sampled tussock

prospective_split_and_evaluation.decision_rule: favorable only if augmented has lower macro log loss than baseline and no outer-country log-loss degradation exceeds the prospectively frozen guardrail; otherwise null/adverse as frozen later before response open

prospective_v2_design.world_generation: response-blind structural_lcc_ladder from frozen eligible-event coordinates; targets and adequacy thresholds must be frozen after Event-core Gate2 and before occurrence member access
prospective_v2_design.prediction_facing_source_policy: source-symmetric calibration-positive source set; arbitrary single-source labels forbidden
prospective_v2_design.train_serve_generator_policy: one generator contract for calibration cross-fit and heldout serving; no Tampa-style train/serve generator shift
prospective_v2_design.static_state_policy: static geography alone is not sufficient for promotion; prediction-facing state must depend on the frozen calibration-positive source set

allowed_operations: one exact one-byte HTTP Range archive size probe

future_gates.gate2: open only meta.xml under frozen member byte identity to bind Event-core and Occurrence-extension member names and schemas
future_gates.gate3: open only Event-core member, build response-independent registry/effort manifest, and compile the v2 eligibility gate
future_gates.response_gate: only if all pre-response gates pass and prediction-facing design is eligible; then freeze exact occurrence parser/count gate/evaluation before any occurrence payload byte
